notes.title: Deathroids Update!
notes.content:
🚀 Major Fix Update Released!

We're happy to roll out a new update focused on improving your gameplay experience. Here’s what’s fixed:

🐧 Linux startup issue resolved – the game now launches properly on Linux systems.

🎮 Joystick bugs fixed – improved compatibility and smoother controls.

🖥️ Screen glitch issues corrected – visuals should now display as intended across setups.

Thank you for your feedback and support. More updates are on the way!

notes.title: Deathroids Update!
notes.content:
Now the gameplay is more pleasurable when your chances get higher!

- New Scoring System
- Hidden Bonuses
- Improved Power Up System
- Game Balancing Implementations
- Bug fixes

New possibilities and ways to multiply your score.

Enjoy!
